facts.application: TPO works application; section 211 notice for unprotected conservation-area trees
facts.guard: portal submission is not authority approval
local register and exceptions require exact authority review

scope_guards: TPO individual, area, group and woodland categories remain distinct.
A conservation-area location does not itself prove that a specific tree has a TPO.
A section 211 notice gives the authority an opportunity to respond and is not a consent grant.
TPO applications must identify the exact tree, proposed work and reasons.
Dead or dangerous-tree exceptions require exact facts and notification rules.
Planning permission does not authorise unrelated tree works beyond its precise scope.
Appeal filing, local web maps and application registers are not final outcomes.
No score or promotion is written without exact order, map, tree identity, decision and site evidence.
